subject: Owners: seg13 = lazy NoteEditor with a working pending-quote path; seg22 = reader render cost (seg06 is approved and idle); seg18 = precache so offline reload works
body: seg13: load NoteEditor lazily in PageNotesPanel and queue pendingQuote until the editor mounts (notes.spec:426 must pass 6/6). The reader keeps nothing from notes/extensions in its static graph: move EMPTY_DOC/isEmptyDoc to a tiny shared module. seg22: bring chapter LCP below 2.5 s on iPad Slow 4G: break the 206 ms long task, defer below-the-fold sections, KaTeX/figure work in idle time, content-visibility for off-screen sections. You may edit reader files under a claim note. seg18: precaching on, with the app shell and the lazy closures listed earlier, so the offline-reload installability step passes. PERF_GATE flips to enforce only after all three are green.
